title: Hosted MCP Server Manifest
description: Schema for submitting an MCP server to the Azure Logic Apps hosted MCP server platform.

$schema.description: Reference to this schema for editor validation.

id.description: Unique server identifier. Lowercase alphanumeric and hyphens only (3-64 chars). This becomes the folder name under servers/ and the image repository under mcp-servers/ in ACR.

name.description: Human-readable display name shown in the Azure portal.

description.description: Short description shown in the server catalog.
examples: Enable AI agents to safely interact with SQL databases using Model Context Protocol.

longDescription.description: Detailed description shown on the server detail page. Supports Markdown.

icon.description: Filename of a square icon committed alongside this manifest in the same servers/{id}/ folder (SVG or PNG, minimum 64x64). The pipeline validates and re-hosts it to our portal CDN; the resolved URL is written to the catalog _meta. External URLs are not accepted. If omitted, a default icon is shown.

recalledVersions.description: Versions of this server that have been recalled (e.g. a critical bug was found). Recalled versions are excluded from 'latest' and from new deployments; auto-update deployments on a recalled version are automatically rolled back to the newest good compatible version. Equivalent to a 'yank' in PyPI/crates. Reverting the PR (removing a version here) un-recalls it.

publisher.description: Information about the server author or organization.

links.description: Useful links for users and reviewers.

source.description: URL to the MCP server source code repository.

support.description: URL for filing issues or getting support.

source.description: How the MCP server is delivered. Discriminated by 'type'. The pipeline always produces an HTTP image for ADC; when transport is 'stdio', the pipeline wraps the server with the McpTransportGateway tool.

type.description: Delivery mechanism: 'container' for a pre-built, digest-pinned image, or 'github' to build the image from source at a pinned commit.

authentication.description: Declares how the server authenticates to its upstream data source. Rendered as a separate 'Authentication' section in the portal. If omitted, no auth section is shown (e.g., Playwright). Managed identity is provided by the Connector Namespace's UAMI, discovered via IMDS - no env var needed.

methods.description: Supported authentication methods. When both are listed, the portal renders a picker; when only one, it's shown directly.

default.description: Default auth method pre-selected in the portal picker. Only meaningful when methods has more than one entry.

connectionStringVariable.description: Environment variable name the connection string is injected as. Required when methods includes 'connection-string'.

configuration.description: Environment variables the server accepts. These become user-configurable settings in the Azure portal.

description.description: User-facing description shown in the portal.

isRequired.description: Whether the server requires this variable to start.

isSecret.description: If true, the value is stored encrypted and masked in the portal.

default.description: Default value if the user does not provide one.

format.description: Value format hint for portal validation.

capabilities.description: MCP capabilities this server supports. Used for filtering in the catalog.

image.description: Digest-pinned image reference from a public registry. Tags are not accepted - use the immutable sha256 digest.

transport.description: MCP transport the image serves. When 'stdio', the pipeline wraps the image with McpTransportGateway to expose HTTP.

command.description: Command that starts the STDIO MCP server inside the image. Required when transport is 'stdio'.

targetPort.description: Port the MCP server listens on inside the container. Required for http; ignored for stdio (the gateway sets port 8080).

mcpServerRoute.description: HTTP path prefix where the MCP SSE/Streamable HTTP endpoint is served. Ignored for stdio (the gateway sets route /mcp).

repo.description: GitHub repository URL containing the MCP server source and Dockerfile.

commit.description: Full 40-character commit SHA. Immutable - ensures we build exactly this version.

dockerfile.description: Path to the Dockerfile relative to the repo root.

buildContext.description: Path to the Docker build context relative to the repo root. Defaults to the repo root.

transport.description: MCP transport the built image serves. When 'stdio', the pipeline wraps the built image with McpTransportGateway to expose HTTP.

command.description: Command that starts the STDIO MCP server inside the built image. Required when transport is 'stdio'.

targetPort.description: Port the MCP server listens on inside the built container. Required for http; ignored for stdio (the gateway sets port 8080).

mcpServerRoute.description: HTTP path prefix where the MCP SSE/Streamable HTTP endpoint is served. Ignored for stdio (the gateway sets route /mcp).
